numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report 'Profitability' section and consolidated statement of profit and loss show revenue of EUR 216,573,760 (2024) vs EUR 189,333,028 (2023). The increase is (216.6-189.3)/189.3 = 14.4%, which rounds to 'nearly 15%'.

numerical_claims.claim: The vehicle and consumer financing net portfolio grew by 16 percent to 371.2 million euros from 320.3 million euros in the previous year
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report 'Growth' section and consolidated statement of financial position show net portfolio of EUR 371,200,000 (2024) vs EUR 320,300,000 (2023). The increase is (371.2-320.3)/320.3 = 15.9%, which rounds to '16%'

numerical_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA increased by over 16 percent to 89.8 million euros compared to 77.5 million euros in 2023
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report 'Profitability' section states Adjusted EBITDA of EUR 89.8 mln (2024) vs EUR 77.5 mln (2023). The increase is (89.8-77.5)/77.5 = 16.0%, which matches 'over 16%'

numerical_claims.claim: The Group achieved an all-time best annual net profit of 29.6 million euros, marking a 21 percent increase from 24.5 million euros in 2023
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report 'Profitability' section and consolidated statement of profit and loss show profit for the period of EUR 29,571,828 (2024) vs EUR 24,455,054 (2023). The increase is (29.6-24.5)/24.5 = 20.8%, which rounds to '21%'
